title: Retry transient feed transport failures
pr_body: Retries short network failures while keeping the per-attempt deadline.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

bugs.anchor: const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
bugs.title: Failed fetch attempts retain deadline timers
bugs.rationale: When fetch rejects, control jumps to catch before clearTimeout. Each retry leaves a live timer and controller until timeout, increasing pending work under repeated transport failures.
